posts.linkedin:
Many small businesses still answer basic questions over the phone instead of online.

A café owner repeats the same address and opening hours to every caller. A clinic receives late‑night calls just to confirm if it is open. A shop loses walk‑in customers because the phone number is hidden below the fold, forcing the owner to stop work to answer. These situations waste time and distract from core work.

I create fast, mobile‑first websites for any small business across India. The basic option provides a simple informational site with responsive design and thirty days of edits. The standard option adds up to five pages and a floating WhatsApp button. The pro bundle includes a full website, an AI‑powered chatbot, and setup of a Google Business Profile. All designs use readable contrast and scalable text for accessibility. The layouts load quickly even on slower connections, and the code follows modern standards to ensure compatibility with all major browsers.

The process starts with the owner describing the products or services and the questions customers ask most often. I then build the site, share a preview, and incorporate any requested changes. The owner pays only after the final version is approved.

With a website, the business hours and location are visible on any phone, so callers do not need to repeat the same information. The chatbot can answer common queries even when the office is closed, reducing interruptions during busy periods. The owner can focus on the actual work rather than fielding repetitive calls. Customers can also find the site through a simple Google search, which further reduces the need for phone contact.

The site does not replace a personal response for complicated inquiries, and it will not generate traffic on its own. The owner still needs to share the link and keep the information up to date.

If this approach sounds useful for your business, DM SITE and tell me what you sell.
posts.bluesky: Most small business sites bury hours and address in a contact page, so customers call just to ask. A mobile-first layout puts timings, map, and WhatsApp upfront. DM SITE if you want to talk about yours.

Prefer a WhatsApp chat or details here?

replies.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out. I build websites for small businesses anywhere in India—shops, clinics, salons, coaching centres, and more. Quick question: is your main problem getting enquiries, converting followers, or managing leads? DM SITE and tell me what you sell.

Of course, no pressure. I can send a one-page summary: what's included, timeline, and price range. Is the hesitation budget, timing, or whether it will actually bring enquiries? If budget is the concern, I can suggest a smaller starting version you can expand later. You pay only after you approve the work.
